title: The Book of 2 John Decoded
author: Brittany Johnson
description: The Book of 2 John — every verse decoded into plain, modern English (DMLV).

verses.kjv: The elder unto the elect lady and her children, whom I love in the truth; and not I only, but also all they that have known the truth;
verses.decoded: The elder writes to the chosen lady and her children, whom I love in the truth; and not only I, but all who know the truth love them too.

verses.kjv: For the truth's sake, which dwelleth in us, and shall be with us for ever.
verses.decoded: Because of the truth that lives in us and will be with us forever.

verses.kjv: Grace be with you, mercy, and peace, from God the Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.
verses.decoded: May grace, mercy, and peace be with you from God the Father and from the Lord Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.

verses.kjv: I rejoiced greatly that I found of thy children walking in truth, as we have received a commandment from the Father.
verses.decoded: I was very happy to find some of your children living in the truth, just as we were commanded by the Father.

verses.kjv: And now I beseech thee, lady, not as though I wrote a new commandment unto thee, but that which we had from the beginning, that we love one another.
verses.decoded: Now I ask you, lady, not as if I am writing a new commandment to you, but the one we have had from the beginning: that we love one another.

verses.kjv: And this is love, that we walk after his commandments. This is the commandment, That, as ye have heard from the beginning, ye should walk in it.
verses.decoded: This is love: that we live according to his commandments. This is the commandment, just as you heard from the beginning, that you should live by it.

verses.kjv: For many deceivers are entered into the world, who confess not that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh. This is a deceiver and an antichrist.
verses.decoded: Many deceivers have gone out into the world who do not confess that Jesus Christ came in the flesh. Anyone like this is a deceiver and an antichrist.

verses.kjv: Look to yourselves, that we lose not those things which we have wrought, but that we receive a full reward.
verses.decoded: Be careful so that you do not lose what we have worked for, but receive a full reward.

verses.kjv: Whosoever transgresseth, and abideth not in the doctrine of Christ, hath not God. He that abideth in the doctrine of Christ, he hath both the Father and the Son.
verses.decoded: Anyone who goes beyond the teaching of Christ and does not remain in it does not have God. But whoever remains in the teaching of Christ has both the Father and the Son.

verses.kjv: If there come any unto you, and bring not this doctrine, receive him not into your house, neither bid him God speed:
verses.decoded: If anyone comes to you and does not bring this teaching, do not welcome them into your home or say 'Good luck' to them.

verses.kjv: For he that biddeth him God speed is partaker of his evil deeds.
verses.decoded: Because anyone who says 'Good luck' to them shares in their evil work.

verses.kjv: Having many things to write unto you, I would not write with paper and ink: but I trust to come unto you, and speak face to face, that our joy may be full.
verses.decoded: I have many things to write to you, but I do not want to write with pen and ink. Instead, I hope to come to you and talk face to face so that our joy may be complete.

verses.kjv: The children of thy elect sister greet thee. Amen.
verses.decoded: The children of your chosen sister send their greetings to you. Amen.
